## Import Object 

```{r}

o <- readRDS(file.path(here(),
                       "Riemondy_analysis",
                       "results",
                       "Riemondy_object.rds"))

```

```{r}

sc_list <- list()
membership_list <- list()

for (s in unique(o$UPN)) {
  obj <- subset(x = o, subset = UPN == s)
  sample_id <- s
  norm <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
  raw  <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  
  scell <- SCimplify(norm, 
                     k.knn = 5, 
                     gamma = 10,
                     n.var.genes = 2000, 
                     verbose = FALSE,
                     n.pc = 10)
  
  cat(sample_id, ": ", ncol(obj), " cells -> ", length(unique(scell$membership)), " supercells\n", sep = "")
  
  membership_list[[s]] <- scell$membership
  
  mem <- scell$membership
  ids <- sort(unique(mem))
  
  # Majority cell type + size per supercell
  meta <- data.frame(ct = obj$tumor_subpopulation[names(scell$membership)],
                     sc = scell$membership) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sc) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    cell_type = names(which.max(table(ct))),
    sc_size   = dplyr::n(),
    purity    = max(table(ct)) / dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()
  rownames(meta) <- paste0(sample_id, "_SC", meta$sc)
  meta$pt_id <- sample_id
  meta$dataset <- "Riemondy"

  
  # Sum RAW counts

  G <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = match(names(mem), colnames(raw)),
    j = match(mem, ids),
    x = 1,
    dims = c(ncol(raw), length(ids)),
    dimnames = list(colnames(raw), as.character(ids))
  )

  SC.counts <- raw %*% G
  colnames(SC.counts) <- paste0(sample_id, "_SC", ids)

  stopifnot(!anyNA(match(names(mem), colnames(raw))))   # every cell found
  stopifnot(sum(SC.counts) == sum(raw))                 # no counts lost
  stopifnot(all(colnames(SC.counts) == rownames(meta))) # matches meta block
  

  so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = SC.counts, meta.data = meta[colnames(SC.counts), ])
  sc_list[[sample_id]] <- so
  
  saveRDS(so, file.path(here(),
                        "Riemondy_analysis",
                        "results",
                        paste0(sample_id, "_scObject.rds")),
          compress = "xz")
  
}

merged <- merge(sc_list[[1]], sc_list[-1])
merged <- JoinLayers(merged)
merged <- NormalizeData(merged) |> 
  FindVariableFeatures() |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA()
merged <- RunHarmony(
  merged,
  group.by.vars = "pt_id",
  theta = 3
)

ndim <- 30

merged <- FindNeighbors(
    merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim
)
  
merged <- FindClusters(
    merged,
    resolution = 0.26,
    random.seed = 20200204
)
  
merged <- RunUMAP(
    merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim,
    seed.use = 20200204,
    min.dist = 0.3
  )
```

```{r}

## CELL -> SUPERCELL LOOKUP

# Cell -> supercell table from membership_list
membership_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(membership_list, function(m, s) {
  data.frame(
    cell   = names(m),
    sample = s,
    sc_id  = paste0(s, "_SC", as.integer(m))   # matches colnames(merged)
  )
})

# Sanity check: do the barcodes match the object on the left plot?
mean(membership_df$cell %in% colnames(without_supercell))
mean(colnames(without_supercell) %in% membership_df$cell)

## ADD SUPERCELL INFO

without_supercell$sc_id <- membership_df$sc_id[
  match(colnames(without_supercell), membership_df$cell)
]

# Pull supercell-level info from the merged SC object
sc_meta <- merged@meta.data[, c("cell_type", "sc_size", "purity", "pt_id")]

without_supercell$sc_celltype <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "cell_type"]
without_supercell$sc_size    <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "sc_size"]
without_supercell$sc_purity  <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "purity"]

# How do original cell types map to SC cell types?
contingency_matrix <- table(original = without_supercell$tumor_subpopulation,
                            sc_celltype = without_supercell$sc_celltype, 
                            useNA = "ifany")

prob_matrix <- prop.table(contingency_matrix, margin = 1) * 100

col_order <- c("SHH-A1", "SHH-A2", "SHH-B1", "SHH-B2", "SHH-C1", "SHH-C2")
prob_matrix <- prob_matrix[, col_order]

Heatmap(
  matrix = prob_matrix,
  name = "Matching %",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 100), c("#A690A4", "#5E4B56")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_title = "Cell Type Identity",
  column_title = "SuperCell Cell Type Identity",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", width = 2),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
          # grid.text places the text exactly inside each cell
          grid.text(paste0(sprintf("%.1f", prob_matrix[i, j]), "%"), x, y, 
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, col = "white"))}
)


## PLOT SUPERCELL ASSIGNMENTS ONTO SINGLE CELL EMBEDDING

# Original cells colored by the cluster their supercell received
p_sc_cluster <- DimPlot(without_supercell, 
                        reduction = "umap",
                        group.by = "sc_celltype", 
                        raster = FALSE,
                        cols = subpop_colors) +
  labs(title = "Original cells colored by SC-cell type")

# Supercell size and purity per cell
p_size   <- FeaturePlot(without_supercell, 
                        "sc_size",
                        reduction = "umap", 
                        raster = FALSE)
p_purity <- FeaturePlot(without_supercell, 
                        "sc_purity", 
                        reduction = "umap", 
                        raster = FALSE)

all3 <- p_sc_cluster | p_size | p_purity

normalvsuper <- p_sc_cluster | p1

ggsave(file.path(here(), 
                 "Riemondy_analysis",
                 "results",
                 "superimposition_SC_Normal_withSize_and_Purity.png"),
       plot = all3,
       width = 24,
       height = 10,
       bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(here(), 
                 "Riemondy_analysis", 
                 "results",
                 "superimposition_SC_NormalComparison.png"),
       plot = normalvsuper,
       width = 16,
       height = 10,
       bg = "white")

## SHOW SUPERCELL CENTROIDS

emb <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(without_supercell, "umap"))
colnames(emb) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
emb$sc_id <- without_supercell$sc_id
emb$sample <- without_supercell$UPN

centroids <- emb |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sc_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sc_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    UMAP_1 = mean(UMAP_1),
    UMAP_2 = mean(UMAP_2),
    n      = dplyr::n(),
    sample = dplyr::first(sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sc_celltype = sc_meta[sc_id, "cell_type"])

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = emb, 
             aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2), 
             color = "grey85", 
             size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = centroids, 
             aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, size = n, color = sc_celltype),
             alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "SuperCell centroids on original UMAP")

## IS GAP PATIENT SPECIFIC?

DimPlot(without_supercell, 
        reduction = "umap", 
        group.by = "tumor_subpopulation",
        split.by = "UPN", 
        ncol = 4, 
        raster = FALSE)
```

```{r}
                             only.pos = FALSE,

                             logfc.threshold = 0)

                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            min.pct = 0, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0)
```

```{r}

## HEATMAP FOR TOP 6 MARKERS 

make_marker_heatmaps <- function(markers, marker_prefix = "C", n_per_cluster = 6,
                                 source_label = "single-cell") {

  # only genes present in both objects
  shared <- intersect(rownames(without_supercell), rownames(merged))

  top <- markers |>
    filter(gene %in% shared, avg_log2FC > 0, pct.1 > 0.25) |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = n_per_cluster, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(cluster)), desc(avg_log2FC))

  genes <- top$gene
  row_group <- factor(paste0(marker_prefix, top$cluster, " markers"),
                      levels = unique(paste0(marker_prefix, top$cluster, " markers")))

  avg_z <- function(obj, group_by, prefix) {
    a <- AverageExpression(obj, 
                           features = genes, 
                           group.by = group_by,
                           assays = "RNA",
                           layer = "data")$RNA
    a <- log1p(as.matrix(a))
    colnames(a) <- sub("^g", "", colnames(a))
    a <- a[genes, order(as.numeric(colnames(a))), drop = FALSE]
    z <- t(scale(t(a)))
    colnames(z) <- paste0(prefix, colnames(z))
    z
  }

  z1 <- avg_z(without_supercell, "tumor_subpopulation", "C")
  z2 <- avg_z(merged,            "cell_type",   "S")

  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))

  mk <- function(mat, title, first = FALSE) {
    Heatmap(
      mat, name = "Row z-score", col = col_fun,
      cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
      # marker blocks: split once, labeled on the left of the first panel only
      row_split = if (first) row_group else NULL,
      row_title_rot = 0, row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
      show_row_names = first, row_names_side = "left",
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "italic"),
      # column labels
      column_title = title, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
      column_names_rot = 0, column_names_centered = TRUE,
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
      border = TRUE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
      width = unit(ncol(mat) * 8, "mm"),
      heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row z-score", at = c(-2, 0, 2),
                                  labels = c("low", "0", "high"))
    )
  }

  ht <- mk(z1, "Single cells\nsingle-cell clusters", first = TRUE) +
        mk(z2, "Supercells\nsupercell clusters")
  draw(ht,
       column_title = paste0("Top ", 
                             n_per_cluster, 
                             " markers per cluster (selected from ",
                             source_label,
                             " data)"),
       column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
       heatmap_legend_side = "right", padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "mm"))
}

# single-cell-derived markers (clusters labeled C0-C4)
make_marker_heatmaps(objMarkers, 
                     marker_prefix = "C", 
                     source_label = "single-cell")

# supercell-derived markers (clusters labeled S0-S4)
make_marker_heatmaps(scMarkers, 
                     marker_prefix = "S", 
                     source_label = "supercell")

```
